the CB1 antagonist, rimonabant, improves insulin sensitivity in obese mice, at least in part, through an adipokine‐dependent mechanism.
adipokines, especially leptin, play an important role in the insulin‐improving effects of CB1 antagonists.

rimonabant‐induced insulin sensitivity is associated with an increase in adiponectin and a decrease in leptin levels, which is independent of changes in adiposity.
